GT Simple Wireless Network bolts a wireless EU layer onto GregTech: measure it, move it, display it, and supervise it — no cables required.

This chapter walks you from the Wireless Energy Monitor and the pocket HUD, through the Link Terminal and its energy covers, to wall-sized info panels, a quantum leap for your ME network, and the Device Info Terminal.

Everything here is LV-era tech. Keep your chunks loaded and your thresholds sane.
